author: fidjissimo
text: While we've benefited from generous investors and donors, our ambitions far exceed our means. So for my birthday, I ask that you consider joining me in curing neuroimmune conditions. You can learn more about Metrodora and donate here: https://t.co/Mx8GODZSvQ

author: fidjissimo
text: We will also be bringing scientists and engineers under the same roof, while deepening our partnerships with the rest of the industry. By removing silos between science and technology, and between academia and industry, we hope to accelerate progress towards a cure.

author: fidjissimo
text: We're also changing how research is done, by allowing patients to contribute their data to the creation of the first biobank of patient samples on these conditions. This way, any scientist, academic, pharma or biotech company will be able to study these conditions much faster.

author: fidjissimo
text: With Metrodora, we’re reimagining how to care for patients with these conditions by creating a clinic where specialists across neurology, immunology, gastroenterology and genetics will work together to address the needs of the whole patient.

author: fidjissimo
text: A year ago, I met the most amazing couple: Laura Pace, a neurogastroenterologist, and James Hemp, a scientist with over 20 years of research experience. Together, we decided that we were going to solve the problem. Metrodora is our solution.

author: fidjissimo
text: Tens of millions of people in the U.S., most of them women, are living with a neuroimmune condition — everything from POTS to multiple sclerosis to lupus. And many women aren’t being treated because doctors don’t believe them, or think the symptoms are psychological.

author: fidjissimo
text:
To celebrate my birthday this year, I am thrilled to unveil Metrodora - an entirely new approach for the care and cure of neuroimmune diseases. Metrodora is a foundation, clinic and research institute that reimagines women's health from the ground up. 
https://t.co/sRkI4kdiXI

author: fidjissimo
text: The pandemic isn’t over, which means Americans everywhere are still struggling. That’s why an increase like this is such a big deal, and why we’ll keep doing our part to help more families put affordable, nutritious food on the table.

author: fidjissimo
text: Since October, @Instacart has partnered with retailers to allow Americans in 39 states and D.C. to pay for groceries using EBT SNAP online payments – the official name for food stamps. And we’re working to expand access to even more people.

author: fidjissimo
text: At @Instacart, we’ve always cared about helping more people get access to food. I’m so happy that @POTUS, @SecVilsack and @USDA have announced the largest increase in food stamp benefits ever – a step that will help millions of families stay healthy.

quoted.text: A modernized Thrifty Food Plan, based on current food prices, consumption data, the nutrients in food, and the latest dietary guidance, is more than a commitment to good nutrition – it’s an investment in our nation’s health, economy, and security. https://t.co/iQb4t68Gl5
